outcomeNote: A bare mishnaic clause with no question, citation or dispute; its biur explicitly marks it as another item in the style of the preceding mishnayot (ועוד בסגנון המשניות הקודמות).

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ טָהוֹר בִּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ – טָמֵא בְּכׇל הַכֵּלִים, טָהוֹר בְּכׇל הַכֵּלִים – טָמֵא בִּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» That which is «ritually pure in an earthenware vessel» is «ritually impure in all the» other types of «vessels;» that which is «ritually pure in all the» other types of «vessels» is «ritually impure in an earthenware vessel.»

moves.cueHe: טהור בכלי חרש – טמא בכל הכלים
moves.summary: states the paired inversion between earthenware and all other vessels, continuing the series of the preceding mishnayot
